intuition: Chronological records allow prefix sums and binary search to isolate any inclusive time range.

brute_force.approach: Scan every recorded exam and sum scores whose times fall in the requested interval.

optimal.approach: Store exam times and cumulative scores; use lower and upper bounds to subtract the prefix before the range.

edge_cases: No exam in the inclusive interval yields zero.
The first exam may be the only record in the queried interval.
